parsed.why: Gender nonconformity itself criminal under uncodified sharia with death available; documented traveller-facing arrest at airport over posts, cross-dressing prosecutions, trans death in custody with disputed official account; welcome messaging is cosmetic.

Appearance-only dress offence exposes any trans visitor in public, but no documented enforcement of it; state-department reports show security forces harassing, detaining and torturing LGBTQ people 2018-2022, and an openly hostile society from which citizens fled.

Decriminalised since 2012, sole LGBTI organisation works freely in all districts with good police relations and police-escorted annual Pride; offset by no general anti-discrimination law, undocumented 2024 assaults, and a legal analysis warning mismatched passports could draw a charge.

No criminalisation and prosecutorial guidance directing prosecutors to treat gender-identity hostility as aggravating, giving victims real recourse; offset by 2024 state policy to ban LGBTQIA advocacy, marriage redefinition, conservative climate and no general discrimination protection.

Enforced criminalisation with a 2024 imprisonment, police as perpetrators of violence and extortion with raised fines, forced anal examinations used as evidence, bars on advocacy, and a presidential statement triggering spikes in hate speech and assaults.
